@graph.name: Rooftop Snipers
@graph.description: Rooftop Snipers is a chaotic, physics-based two-player sniper duel created by Michael Carriere. Jump, dodge, and snipe opponents off rooftop arenas to win 5 rounds.

acceptedAnswer.text: Rooftop Snipers is a popular two-button ragdoll sniper game where two players stand on a building rooftop and attempt to shoot each other off the edge using various weapons and unpredictable physics.

mainEntity.name: Can I play Rooftop Snipers unblocked at school or work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! On playrooftopsnipers.github.io, you can play Rooftop Snipers unblocked directly in your web browser with no firewall restrictions, no downloads, and no plugins required.

mainEntity.name: How do you control players in Rooftop Snipers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Player 1 uses 'W' to jump/flip and 'E' to aim and shoot. Player 2 uses 'I' to jump/flip and 'O' to aim and shoot. Holding the jump key triggers a backward flip, while holding the shoot key raises the weapon arm.

mainEntity.name: Is Rooftop Snipers free to play?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Rooftop Snipers is 100% free to play on desktop, Chromebook, and laptop devices with zero installation.
